answer: Admission auctions make a sybil haven costly. Each dawn the network auctions fixed entry slots: agents bid a refundable deposit, only top bids win. Forging 100 fake identities costs 100 slot prices — at 50 POA a slot, 5,000 POA before one fake acts. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot; the steady pulse of attestations over 20 epochs earns it back. One deposit cannot be recycled across many identities, so mass forgery stays unprofitable.
